article.headline: Seven Irish Counties Face Cleanup After Heavy Rain and Gusty Winds
article.summary: Status Yellow wind and rain warnings expired for seven Irish counties this morning following a major weather event.
article.body:
Meteorologist Mark Bowe described the situation as a double whammy, with heavy rain and very strong, gusty winds causing localized flooding and scattered debris across the country. Falling leaves and trees on roads created difficult travel conditions throughout the warning period, which stretched from southern regions to the northwest. The combined force of the elements posed significant challenges for commuters and residents in impacted areas like Cork, Kerry, Waterford, Clare, Galway, Mayo, and Sligo.

This disruption is far from over, as the incoming week promises little relief for those dealing with the aftermath. Because low-pressure systems remain anchored in the region, the weather is expected to stay unsettled through Thursday. Residents should prepare for blustery showers and inconsistent conditions that make it unlikely the weather will feel as though it has improved significantly in the near term.

According to Met Éireann, the warnings in place for the seven counties expired at 4am today. While these specific alerts have lifted, additional wind warnings for Donegal and maritime gale warnings for the Irish Sea remain active, with gale force 8 to strong gale force 9 winds expected to persist in those sectors until later this morning. The forecaster notes that while occasional sunshine may appear, the overarching theme for the coming days remains cold and unstable, with a continuous potential for further scattered showers.

article.headline: Harry Styles, Sam Fender and Billie Eilish Headline Record Breaking Glastonbury 2027
article.summary: Harry Styles, Sam Fender, and Billie Eilish will headline Glastonbury 2027, with Cher appearing in the Sunday legends slot.
article.body:
Tickets for the 2027 festival vanished in just 42 minutes, marking the fastest sell-out following the event's 2026 fallow year to allow Worthy Farm to recover. Attendees will face the highest ticket prices in the festival's history at £408, including a £5 booking fee per person. For this return to Somerset, organizers have secured the youngest group of headliners seen in the 21st century, with Sam Fender and Harry Styles appearing at 33 years old and Billie Eilish at 25.

This headline selection represents a significant shift for the event, offering a blend of debut performances and returning stars. Sam Fender opens the Pyramid stage on Friday, Harry Styles performs on Saturday, and Billie Eilish returns to close the event on Sunday night. For Harry Styles, this marks his first time performing at the festival, while Sam Fender returns as a Mercury Prize winner following his 2022 appearance. Billie Eilish, having debuted on the Other stage in 2019, continues her history with the festival as a two-time headliner.

Beyond the Pyramid stage, the festival will host several notable debuts. US pop icon Cher is confirmed for the Sunday afternoon legends slot, which serves as a fourth headline set. Additionally, electro pioneers Kraftwerk will make their debut by headlining the West Holts stage. The line-up also includes performances from Adéla, FKA Twigs, Primal Scream, Kacey Musgraves, and experimental duo Angine de Poitrine. 

Festival organizer Emily Eavis noted that the early musical taster reflects a commitment to the event's return to Worthy Farm. Music on the main stages is scheduled to begin on Friday 25 June, welcoming 200,000 fans to the site. Further lineup announcements are expected from the organizers in the new year.

With Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler both sidelined for this contest, the pressure is mounting for the Lakers to adjust their rotation at the five-spot, utilizing Kevon Looney, Sandro Mamukelashvili, and Jarred Vanderbilt to compensate for the missing depth. 

Managing this deficit is critical for a Lakers squad aiming to extend their eight-game winning streak. While Los Angeles holds an impressive 12-2 record on the season, they have recently struggled with maintaining leads, including a notable instance where they allowed a 31-point lead to slip away against the Phoenix Suns. Resolving these defensive lapses and rebounding concerns is essential if they hope to continue their current momentum in the West. 

For the Lakers, this game serves as a test of their depth and resilience without Kessler, who has been a key contributor. The Hornets enter the matchup with a 4-9 record but pose a legitimate threat from the perimeter, as four of their five starters are capable of stretching the floor. Los Angeles must now pivot to contain Charlotte’s high-volume shooting and backcourt duo of Brandon Miller and Coby White to avoid a home loss that would break their current streak.

article.headline: England Surges to 2/113 as Australia Battles Injury Setbacks in Series Decider
article.summary: England elected to bat first in the ODI series decider at Bellerive Oval today after leveling the series with a 135-run win in Adelaide.
article.body:
England reached 2/113 after 15 overs in the series decider at Hobart’s Bellerive Oval, with batsman Ben Duckett anchoring the innings at the half-century mark. Skipper Harry Brook chose to bat first on a pitch he deemed favorable, keeping the same squad that secured a decisive 135-run victory in Adelaide to force this final showdown. Former captain Michael Vaughan labeled England the favorites for the match, citing the absence of Australia’s top seam bowlers as a critical advantage for the visitors. 

This series decider carries high stakes for both nations, effectively acting as a final to determine the overall winner. For Australia, the match represents a test of depth as they navigate a challenging injury list and look to contain a confident English lineup that has momentum from their previous performance. The outcome hinges on whether Australia's adjusted bowling attack can disrupt England’s momentum in this pressure-filled encounter.

Australia’s team selection has been forced into flux due to late medical withdrawals. Leg-spinner Adam Zampa was ruled out just before the match due to back spasms, leading to the return of young quick Mahli Beardman. Alex Carey also joins the side for the Hobart clash. Beardman enters the match following a breakout debut performance where he took 6-24, a feat that drew comparisons to Pat Cummins and followed private mentorship sessions with fast-bowling legend Dennis Lillee. 

While Vaughan remains confident in England’s position, Australian cricket figure Mark Waugh noted the inconsistency displayed by both sides throughout the series, leaving the ultimate result unpredictable. England will look to capitalize on their early surge to set a challenging target, while Australia relies on its new-look attack to keep the tourists in check.

article.headline: Tsunami advisory cancelled for North Island after mysterious surge hits coastal gauges
article.summary: The National Emergency Management Agency lifted a coastal tsunami alert for Napier and Gisborne following unusual tidal gauge activity on Wednesday.
article.body:
Tidal gauges at Napier and Gisborne recorded surges reaching up to 60cm on Wednesday evening, prompting a rapid precautionary response. The activity appeared suddenly on instruments used by geohazards analysts, triggering a national advisory that warned of strong currents and unpredictable surges capable of injuring or drowning swimmers and those near the water. While the threat was perceived as severe enough to activate a specialized tsunami expert panel, no public mobile alerts were issued during the brief window of concern. 

This incident highlights the challenges of monitoring coastal hazards where no seismic trigger is present. Because there was no recorded earthquake, emergency officials focused their efforts on managing the risk to people in harbours, marinas, and near estuaries without causing unnecessary widespread alarm. The advisory served as a due diligence measure to ensure civil defence partners were prepared while experts investigated the potential for sudden underwater movements. 

According to the National Emergency Management Agency, the threat was officially cancelled at 6:04pm, just 26 minutes after the advisory was first issued at 5:38pm. Officials report that while the signals have since subsided, the exact cause of the phenomenon remains unidentified. Researchers are currently exploring various possibilities, including the potential for an underwater landslide or specific weather-related changes that could have displaced enough water to fluctuate the gauges. 

Ongoing monitoring efforts continue to track the coastal waters of Hawke's Bay and Tai Rāwhiti. Experts from Earth Sciences New Zealand are working to pinpoint the source of the activity, though they confirm there is no longer a risk to the shoreline.

article.headline: Quentin Grimes scores career-high 47 points in Lakers overtime comeback win
article.summary: Quentin Grimes led the Los Angeles Lakers back from an 18-point deficit to defeat the Charlotte Hornets 118-114 in overtime on Tuesday.
article.body:
Quentin Grimes erupted for a career-high 47 points, including 23 points in the fourth quarter and overtime, to spark the Los Angeles Lakers' improbable 118-114 comeback victory against the Charlotte Hornets. The Lakers trailed by as many as 18 points during the contest, struggling against a Hornets offense led by Brandon Miller and Naz Reid, who scored 23 points. Despite missing key starters Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler, the Lakers secured their ninth straight win by surging in the final frame.

The comeback was essential for the Lakers, who navigated significant foul trouble for Luka Dončić, who picked up four fouls in the first half alone. With Dončić limited, the Lakers relied on a massive effort on the boards, securing 19 offensive rebounds to generate 19 second-chance points. The victory maintains the team's momentum following a successful four-game road trip, proving the team's resilience despite shooting 41.4% from the field and trailing by seven at halftime.

According to Silver Screen and Roll, Grimes kept the team within reach early by hitting two triples before his massive fourth-quarter performance forced the game into the extra period. Lakers Nation reported that the Hornets, despite being the lowest-ranked offensive team in the NBA, held a 66-59 lead at the half, but could not contain Grimes as he recorded his first 40-point game in a Lakers uniform. The Lakers managed to tighten their defense down the stretch, forcing turnovers that allowed them to tie the game at 104 in the closing minutes.

article.headline: NHS staff caught snooping on patient medical records over 3,000 times
article.summary: Health workers in England accessed sensitive patient information without authorization in 3,029 incidents recorded between 2021 and 2026.
article.body:
Records of a three-year-old boy, victims of the 2024 Southport attack, and victims of the 2023 Nottingham attack were among the files inappropriately accessed by hospital personnel. These instances of unauthorized snooping, documented in a five-year period, reflect a recurring issue where staff inspect information belonging to people they know or satisfy personal curiosity. 

Data breaches of this nature damage the relationship between the health service and the public. Patient advocates emphasize that these actions are distressing for families and fundamentally erode the trust required when individuals provide the NHS with their most sensitive personal information. A reported lack of transparency from some organizations following these discoveries has further compounded the negative impact on patients.

According to the Press Association, 3,029 incidents occurred across England between 2021-22 and 2025-26. This figure is likely an underestimate of the true scale, as only 79 of 143 acute hospital and ambulance trusts provided precise data, while others failed to report exact numbers. The Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) has identified over 300 reports this year alone regarding staff looking at records without a legitimate reason or sharing information with third parties.

Regulators are now demanding immediate improvements to data security. Paul Arnold, chief executive of the ICO, has written to health leaders across the UK to call for a definitive end to these breaches. Organizations are expected to implement more rigorous access controls, enhance monitoring systems, increase staff training, and ensure consistent disciplinary actions are taken when violations occur. Trusts are also reminded of their legal obligation to report any breaches that pose a risk to patient rights to the ICO within 72 hours.
